How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate - II Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR CFTRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate – II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate – II position at CSIR CFTRI is 23 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate – II post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (Food/Biotech/chemical) with 2 years of R&D experience, or a Master's/Integrated Master's degree in Engineering or Technology (Food/Biotechnology/Chemical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate – II position is 35 years as of 23 August 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate – II role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 35,000 per month, plus HRA. The exact amount depends on whether the candidate is NET/GATE qualified.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate – II position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Project Associate – II position at CSIR CFTRI.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR CFTRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR CFTRI is located in Mysuru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions, so candidates from other states are likely eligible to apply if they meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article, along with a link to the official CSIR CFTRI website.
